name: Illidan's Favor removes Manaburn/Felbane's cost and adds Manaburn jump targets (#896)
contract: Illidan's Favor 520592 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc=17, SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS) with EffectBasePoints=4, DieSides=1 (real +5), classmask matching Manaburn 805248 by SpellFamilyFlags (dword0 bit24). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (misc=14, SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints=-101, DieSides=1 (real -100%), classmask additionally matching Felbane 525001 (dword1 bit13). Manaburn's single-target shape (ChainTarget=0, no SPELL_ATTR2_CHAIN_FROM_CASTER) is exactly what Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets expects, so SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS adds 5 targets; SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost's generic SPELLMOD_COST application zeroes both spells' cost.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Manaburn jump targets without Illidan's Favor
Manaburn jump targets with Illidan's Favor (+5)
